Craft

Women artisans in rural Pakistan stitch every embroidered piece by hand, using traditional techniques of the sub-continent.

Mukesh work

Kamdani

Mukesh, also known as Kamdani, is used to highlight embroidery or add embellishment to formal fabric. A specially made metallic wire is worked into different patterns on the cloth. It is hugely popular across the sub-continent.

Tarkashi

Thread weaving

Tarkashi is one of the most popular handworks and demands precise expertise. The artisan builds the design directly on the fabric by weaving and threading with a needle.

More from our artisans

Alongside Tarkashi and Mukesh, our artisans work in these crafts and "all kinds of hand craft of sub-continent culture". We also have a dedicated team for block printing and digital printing.

  • Tarkashi
  • Mukesh (Kamdani)
  • Gota work
  • Cross stitch
  • Running stitch
  • Filling stitch
  • Balochi embroidery
  • Afghani embroidery
  • Block printing
  • Digital printing
